comment: Curated starter models (dev spec §8). Data file so the roster can change per release without code changes. Refs must be pullable by a stock Ollama install: registry tags or hf.co GGUF refs. downloadBytes is the Q4_K_M download size and drives the fit check: the app computes need = downloadBytes + 20% (KV cache) + 1 GiB (runtime) and tiers it against the usable memory of the single best discrete GPU (free VRAM minus a 512 MiB safety margin; never summed across GPUs, integrated parts ignored) and system RAM — 'gpu' when need fits, 'split' when it fits VRAM plus 60% of RAM (partly on CPU, slower), 'tight' otherwise; unknown hardware is never gated. 'recommended' here is only the fallback badge for unmeasurable hardware: on a measured machine the app badges the largest model that fits the GPU, or the smallest if none does. minRamBytes is OPTIONAL and only a floor: set it when a model needs more working room than the standard margin (huge vocab, long default context) and the app will use max(computed, minRamBytes). Do not set it to a total-RAM guide — that was the old semantics and it mis-ranked big-GPU machines. Roster researched Aug 2026: Mag Mell R1 is the community-favorite 12B (HammerAI's most-pulled model); Stheno v3.2 the perennial 8B entry pick; Impish LLAMA 4B the rare RP-specific small model; Cydonia the current 24B-class favorite.

models.name: Impish LLAMA
models.description: Small and quick, made for roleplay. Runs on almost anything — the pick for laptops without a big GPU.

models.name: Stheno v3.2
models.description: The classic starter roleplay model — dependable character voice, good pace on mid-range machines.

models.name: Mag Mell R1
models.description: The community favorite for immersive roleplay — rich prose and strong character consistency.

models.name: Cydonia
models.description: Big-machine pick: deeper, more nuanced writing if you have the memory for it.
